title: National Catalogue of Statutory Legal & Regulatory Rules for France

sources: Legifrance (Code de commerce, Code civil, Code du travail)

rules.title: Share Capital Deposit & Escrow Certificate
rules.description: Mandatory deposit of initial cash contributions forming the share capital with an accredited bank, notaire, or the Caisse des Dépôts, generating the deposit certificate required for signing constitutional bylaws.
rules.whyItApplies: Every commercial company formation in France (SAS, SARL, SASU, EURL) mandates the prior deposit of founding share capital.

officialSource.title: Share capital deposit for commercial companies
officialSource.articleReference: Code de commerce, Articles L223-7 et L225-3
officialSource.notes: The deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt) is mandatory for official company registration.

rules.evidenceLabel: Share capital deposit certificate issued by an accredited financial institution

rules.title: Drafting & Formal Execution of Constitutional Bylaws (Statuts)
rules.description: Drafting constitutional bylaws defining corporate governance, corporate purpose, registered name, duration, and shareholding split among founding partners.
rules.whyItApplies: Mandatory founding document governing the legal, governance, and operational rules of the enterprise.

officialSource.title: Drafting articles of association for a company
officialSource.notes: Bylaws must be initialed and signed by all founding shareholders.

rules.evidenceLabel: Executed constitutional bylaws signed by all founding shareholders

rules.title: Publication of Incorporation Notice in Legal Gazette (JAL)
rules.description: Mandatory publication of a legal notice of incorporation in an authorized legal gazette (JAL) or certified digital press service in the département of the registered headquarters to inform third parties.
rules.whyItApplies: Statutory public notice formality required prior to filing the registration dossier.

officialSource.title: Legal notices: publication in an authorized journal
officialSource.notes: The publication certificate (attestation de parution) is required by the INPI Guichet Unique.

rules.evidenceLabel: Publication certificate issued by an authorized Legal Gazette (JAL)

rules.title: Company Registration via INPI Guichet Unique (SIREN & Kbis)
rules.description: Mandatory company registration filing via the INPI Guichet Unique portal to register in the National Register of Companies (RNE) and Trade Register (RCS), issuing SIREN, SIRET numbers, and official Kbis extract.
rules.whyItApplies: Under French law (PACTE Act), the INPI Guichet Unique is the sole legal channel for incorporating any enterprise in France.

officialSource.title: Single window portal for business formalities
officialSource.notes: Assigns official SIREN/SIRET numbers and generates the formal Kbis extract.

rules.evidenceLabel: Official Kbis extract or Guichet Unique filing confirmation receipt

rules.title: Declaration of Beneficial Ownership (RBE Register)
rules.description: Mandatory statutory declaration identifying any individual exercising direct or indirect control over the company (holding more than 25% of capital or voting rights) under anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing obligations.
rules.whyItApplies: Statutory obligation for all registered commercial enterprises in France.

officialSource.authority: INPI / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce
officialSource.title: Declaration of beneficial owners
officialSource.articleReference: Code monétaire et financier, Articles L561-46 et R561-55
officialSource.notes: Submitted concurrently with the company incorporation filing.

rules.title: Trademark & Brand Name Protection (INPI Register)
rules.description: Verification of brand name availability on the INPI register, registration in relevant Nice classes, and execution of formal IP assignment agreements between founders/contractors and the corporate entity.
rules.whyItApplies: Your venture markets a proprietary solution with a distinctive commercial identity and digital assets requiring intellectual property protection.

officialSource.authority: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
officialSource.title: Filing a trademark in France
officialSource.articleReference: Code de la propriété intellectuelle, Article L711-1
officialSource.notes: Search the INPI trademark database prior to filing to prevent infringement conflicts.

rules.evidenceLabel: INPI trademark filing certificate or IP assignment agreement

rules.title: GDPR Privacy Policy & Data Subject Disclosures
rules.description: Drafting and publication of a comprehensive Privacy Policy detailing data processing purposes, legal bases, third-party recipients, retention periods, and rights of access, rectification, and erasure.
rules.whyItApplies: Your service collects or processes personal data of individuals residing within the European Union.

officialSource.title: GDPR: Getting started with compliance
officialSource.articleReference: Règlement Général sur la Protection des Données (RGPD), Articles 12, 13 et 14
officialSource.notes: Must be easily accessible on all data collection forms and interfaces.

rules.evidenceLabel: Published Privacy Policy URL or formal documentation

rules.title: Cookie Consent Management & User Tracking Compliance
rules.description: Implementation of a Consent Management Platform (CMP) conforming to CNIL guidelines, enabling website visitors to accept or refuse non-essential cookies and analytics trackers with equal ease.
rules.whyItApplies: Your platform deploys web analytics, audience measurement, or tracking cookies requiring prior free and informed consent.

officialSource.title: Cookies and trackers: applicable regulatory standards
officialSource.articleReference: Loi Informatique et Libertés, Article 82 et Lignes directrices CNIL (Délibération 2020-091)
officialSource.notes: Refusal must be as easy as acceptance (a visible 'Refuse All' button is mandatory).

rules.evidenceLabel: Screenshot or configuration link of the active Cookie Consent Banner

rules.title: Maintenance of GDPR Processing Activities Register (Art. 30)
rules.description: Creation and recurring maintenance of an internal register recording every category of personal data processing (customer accounts, billing, customer support, personnel).
rules.whyItApplies: Statutory obligation to document ongoing compliance with GDPR personal data processing principles.

officialSource.title: Register of processing activities
officialSource.articleReference: Règlement Général sur la Protection des Données (RGPD), Article 30
officialSource.notes: CNIL provides an official downloadable register template.

rules.evidenceLabel: Completed GDPR Article 30 Processing Register document

rules.title: Mandatory Legal Notices for Website & App (LCEN)
rules.description: Mandatory publication of complete legal notices on the website or mobile app: company name, legal structure, share capital, registered address, RCS and EU VAT numbers, publication director name, and hosting provider details.
rules.whyItApplies: Every electronic communication service open to the public in France is legally required to publish statutory legal notices.

officialSource.title: Mandatory legal disclosures on professional websites
officialSource.articleReference: Loi n° 2004-575 pour la confiance dans l'économie numérique (LCEN), Article 6
officialSource.notes: Failing to provide mandatory legal notices can incur fines up to €75,000.

rules.evidenceLabel: Direct URL link to public Legal Notices (Mentions Légales) page

rules.title: General Terms of Sale (CGV) & Consumer Protection
rules.description: Drafting and pre-purchase acceptance of consumer Terms of Sale specifying total price including taxes (TTC), service execution terms, statutory warranties, and 14-day statutory right of withdrawal information with standard form.
rules.whyItApplies: Your business model sells digital services or products directly to consumer retail customers in France.

officialSource.title: Distance selling: consumer contract requirements
officialSource.articleReference: Code de la consommation, Articles L221-18 et suivants
officialSource.notes: For immediate digital content delivery, express waiver of the 14-day retraction right must be collected.

rules.evidenceLabel: Published General Terms of Sale (CGV) for Consumers

rules.title: B2B Commercial Terms of Sale & Payment Terms
rules.description: Drafting commercial terms of sale applicable to B2B business relationships, specifying payment timelines, statutory late payment interest rates, and mandatory €40 fixed recovery indemnity.
rules.whyItApplies: Your offering addresses businesses, self-employed professionals, or corporate entities.

officialSource.title: Commercial terms of sale between professionals
officialSource.articleReference: Code de commerce, Articles L441-1 et L441-10
officialSource.notes: B2B terms must be communicated upon request to any professional buyer.

rules.evidenceLabel: Formalized B2B Terms of Sale document

rules.title: 3-Click Online Subscription Cancellation Mechanism
rules.description: Integration of a direct, easily accessible, and free online feature allowing consumers to cancel ongoing subscriptions in a simplified workflow not exceeding three clicks.
rules.whyItApplies: You offer recurring subscription plans online to consumer customers in France.

officialSource.title: Electronic contract cancellation in 3 clicks
officialSource.articleReference: Code de la consommation, Article L215-1-1 (Décret n° 2023-417)
officialSource.notes: Mandatory French consumer protection requirement in force since June 1, 2023.

rules.evidenceLabel: Functional verification or screenshot of the 3-click cancellation flow

rules.title: Online Payment Gateway Compliance (DSP2 & PCI-DSS)
rules.description: Selection of an ACPR-licensed Payment Service Provider (PSP) enforcing Strong Customer Authentication (3DS2) and shielding the business from handling raw credit card data (PCI-DSS SAQ-A scope).
rules.whyItApplies: Your platform directly collects online payments via credit card or SEPA direct debit.

officialSource.title: Online payment security and DSP2 regulation
officialSource.articleReference: Code monétaire et financier, Article L133-44 (Directive DSP2)
officialSource.notes: Major PSPs like Stripe or Adyen supply the PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliance certificate.

rules.evidenceLabel: Payment provider compliance confirmation or integration certificate

rules.title: Marketplace Platform Transparency & Disclosure Rules
rules.description: Drafting platform Terms of Service (CGU) disclosing listing criteria, ranking algorithms, search visibility, vendor status (professional or private individual), and any corporate ownership ties.
rules.whyItApplies: Your venture operates as a digital marketplace connecting buyers and sellers of products or services.

officialSource.title: Online platforms and transparency obligations
officialSource.articleReference: Code de la consommation, Article L111-7 et Décret n° 2017-1434
officialSource.notes: Strict transparency obligations for digital intermediaries and matching platforms.

rules.title: Professional Liability Insurance Coverage (RC Pro)
rules.description: Underwriting a professional liability insurance policy tailored to the sector to cover physical, material, and consequential damages that may arise during business operations.
rules.whyItApplies: Recommended for commercial entities to protect against operational liability and client contract risks.

officialSource.title: Professional liability insurance for businesses
officialSource.notes: Essential for commercial contracts, corporate client onboarding, and tender bids.

rules.evidenceLabel: Valid Professional Liability Insurance (RC Pro) certificate

rules.title: Social Security Affiliation & Pre-Hiring Filings (URSSAF)
rules.description: Registration with the relevant French social security regime (General Social Security for SAS/SASU executives or Self-Employed regime for SARL managing partners) and statutory filings (DPAE, periodic social declarations).
rules.whyItApplies: Statutory obligation for active commercial entities remunerating officers, founders, or employees.

officialSource.title: Business creator: social declarations and contributions
officialSource.articleReference: Code de la sécurité sociale, Articles L311-3 et L611-1
officialSource.notes: Initial social registration details are automatically transmitted via the INPI Guichet Unique.

rules.evidenceLabel: URSSAF social security affiliation or compliance certificate

rules.title: Regulated Activity Licensing & Qualification Checks
rules.description: Verification and acquisition of professional licenses, state certifications, administrative permits, or professional body registrations prior to incorporation if the venture operates in a regulated French sector.
rules.whyItApplies: Your sector exhibits characteristics of regulated professions requiring statutory qualification confirmation.

officialSource.title: Regulated activities in France
officialSource.notes: For regulated activities, the commercial court registry rejects incorporation without required permits.

rules.evidenceLabel: State qualification certificate, professional card, or administrative permit
